selection: 25 previously frozen views for legacy scenes; middle 25 consecutive cached SAM3 views for all other scenes. Same frozen geometry, crop policy and predictions as prior B.

arms.B: Fresh object-memory baseline: at most 3 representative views, fallback to remaining eligible crops on absent consensus.
arms.D: B plus targeted context review on unknown name, SAM3/VLM category conflict, or disagreement between actually inferred view names. Up to 3 previously uninferred eligible frames; if fewer than two available, revisit up to 3 distinct existing frames with context. Two distinct context frames with strict label majority may replace naming metadata; no consensus retains B.
arms.E: Decision-only ablation over D's exact inference: additionally require context consensus to match the existing SAM3 instance class under the pre-existing alias dictionary. Otherwise retain B. Not a separately timed model run.

context_image: Unmodified close-up on left plus 3x target-bbox wider crop on right, red target rectangle, each panel 384x384 with aspect-preserving letterboxing. Target bbox from the same local SAM3 mask. No generated pixels, category hints, old VLM answers or GT in prompt.
model: Existing qwen3vl_2b_nf4, same verified weights, original generation/pixel settings, one persistent model process per arm; two CPU threads. No CLIP.

evaluation.GT_access: After all predictions are sealed. No threshold changes or new synonym rules after evaluation.
evaluation.primary: Existing fixed GT-supported naming protocol unchanged: 5cm, at least 30 supported points, >=50% support, >=80% dominant GT object, >=2 eligible source frames, shared-vocabulary foreground. Correct/incorrect/unknown/out-of-vocabulary separately. Report development and heldout separately, baseline-correct regressions and newly correct objects.
evaluation.repeatability: Per-crop labels, review triggers/frames, final names, map-array parity across repeated runs.
evaluation.timing: Actual post-SAM3 fusion, selection, fresh VLM startup, base inference, context preprocessing/inference and backfill; no full RGB-D end-to-end claim.
evaluation.secondary_crop_diagnostic: For reviewed crops only, post-seal GT-pose backprojection of original SAM3 mask depth pixels, nearest GT mesh <=5cm, >=30 supported mask pixels and >=80% one-GT-object purity. Existing aliases only. Separate from map-level diagnostic to investigate image/3D association conflicts; not independent frames/objects accuracy and not used to select changes.

promotion: Experimental only. Preserve original semantic IDs, instance ownership and geometry. Do not deploy or tune on known GT failure.
